name: tiebapostbackuptool
description: Automatically backup tieba posts in a single click

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:service
scripts.start: npm run build:service && node --import tsx src/service/server.ts
scripts.test: npm run build:all && node --import tsx --test tests/core.test.ts tests/compression.test.ts tests/api.test.ts tests/browser.test.ts tests/server.test.ts
scripts.regression:live: npm run build:service && node --import tsx scripts/regression-live.ts
